verdict.rationale: Recurly documents data imports to populate accounts, and the import/export docs mention customer records and subscriptions. A community user also notes the Recurly gateway includes credit card portability. However, nothing documents importing live subscriptions from a spreadsheet or competitor, PCI-compliant card vault transfer into Recurly, or a migration that customers wouldn't notice. Missing for 10: explicit subscription import from CSV or competitor platforms, documented PCI-compliant inbound card data migration, continuity of billing dates and no re-authentication for customers, and hands-on corroboration of a live migration.
